Conceited were they that ruled from so high yet stooped so low. This nexus of debased purity is the perfect place to find a vampire. Probably.
Windows, marked with a cross, spawn randomly at set locations on the stage. Destroying a window causes it to explode in a pillar of light, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
The hyper mode for this map can be unlocked by defeating the Trinacria (25:00) in normal mode.

If the player survives to the 30:00 mark, all of the stage's remaining enemies disappear, the Speed-up effect is disabled and the background fades to black. This is followed by a 30 second countdown, before translucent images of

The four hidden stage items are also present if the player has obtained the Yellow Sign and defeated The Ender.
Rosaries can be found south of the starting area, each located one tileset (map tile) away from the previous one.
One relic is located in Cappella Magna.
Waves in Cappella Magna approach from all four sides of the player.
